items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: INTERVIEWEE: Yeah that is very true.

ctx.x: Because he wrote it when we were both with Don [Unintelligible]. But when he came to Duke and Duke called it Sultry Serenade or whatever he called it, it became a different tune. I mean it was a whole other thing from what we used to play. The melody was the same but Duke put it into context which I am sure made a whole lot more money for Tyre then the record we made in France.
